ABOUT US
Design. Build. Remodel.
The Wade Difference
At Wade Design & Construction, we believe great design starts with listening.

Every home—and every homeowner—is unique, so we begin by understanding how you live, what matters most to you, and how your space needs to function day to day. From there, we develop a personalized plan that brings fresh ideas and thoughtful solutions to the table.

With over 25 years of experience remodeling homes across Southeastern Wisconsin—including Mequon, Cedarburg, Bayside, Fox Point, Whitefish Bay, River Hills, Thiensville, Milwaukee, and beyond—we take pride in creating spaces that feel like they were always meant to be yours. Our team brings creativity, craftsmanship, and care to every project, helping you transform your home into a place that truly reflects you.

CALL US

The Team Behind the Work

At Wade Design & Construction, our greatest strength is the people behind the work. We’re a close-knit team of designers, project managers, and team members who believe great remodeling starts with listening. By working together, and alongside you, we create a thoughtful, organized, and transparent process that turns ideas into beautifully finished spaces. We approach every detail with care, precision, and a commitment to craftsmanship that stands the test of time.

DESIGN
Every great home begins with a conversation. In our first meeting, we take time to understand how you live and what you envision for your space. We’ll explore ideas, walk through possibilities, and begin shaping a design plan that reflects your goals, style, and everyday needs.
BUILD
We partner with a trusted team of local craftspeople who share our values—exceptional quality, clear communication, and deep respect for your home. Their attention to detail and commitment to doing things right help ensure your project moves forward with care and craftsmanship.
REMODEL
Remodeling is where our expertise shines. From kitchens and baths to whole-home transformations, we bring decades of experience and a passion for problem-solving to every project. And even after the dust settles, we’re always here to support you and your home.

WHOLE-HOME REMODELING
Renovated with Intention. Built Around You.

At Wade Design & Construction, we don’t just remodel houses—we reimagine how you live in your home. A whole-home remodel is a chance to start fresh without moving, and we approach that opportunity with care, creativity, and precision.

We begin by listening. How do you move through your home? What works, and what doesn’t? From there, we create a design that’s rooted in functionality and elevated by craftsmanship. Every square inch should work hard, look beautiful, and feel right. This isn’t surface-level change. It’s a deeper kind of transformation: rethinking layout, improving flow, updating systems, and selecting finishes that reflect your style and stand up to real life.

Whether that means opening up rooms, relocating key spaces, or simply making things feel more connected, our goal is a home that functions beautifully—everywhere you look.

Ready to get started?
Complete the form to reach out today to schedule your whole-home remodeling consultation with Wade Design & Construction.
Thoughtful Design,
Down to the Details

Real comfort comes from the details you can’t always put on a plan—the things you feel every time you move through your space. That’s why we pay attention to the little things, from how sunlight travels through your home to where outlets are tucked behind furniture.

You'll see our attention to detail in:
Seamless cabinetry transitions that create visual consistency
Trim lines and finishes that feel intentional, not distracting
Sightlines that open up the home and invite connection
Storage solutions that blend in beautifully
Floorplans that make movement feel effortless
A Cohesive Team. A Clear Vision.

When you work with Wade Design & Construction, you're working with a unified team that collaborates from start to finish. Our designers and project managers stay in sync throughout the process, ensuring that your goals—and the details that matter most to you—are carried through at every stage.

It’s a process built on communication, coordination, and care—so you can enjoy the transformation without the stress.
Ready for a Home That Works Better for You?
If your home no longer fits the way you live, it may be time to reimagine it from the inside out. With thoughtful design, skilled craftsmanship, and a team that truly listens, we’ll help you transform what’s not working into something that feels just right.
Reach out today to schedule your whole-home remodeling consultation with Wade Design & Construction.

BATHROOM REMODELING
Elevated Design. Everyday Comfort.

Bathrooms are among the most-used rooms in your home—and too often, the most overlooked. At Wade Design & Construction, we transform these essential spaces into thoughtfully designed, highly functional retreats that feel as good as they look.

A successful bathroom remodel is about more than tile and fixtures. It’s about eliminating daily frustrations—lack of storage, poor lighting, awkward layouts—and replacing them with smart, lasting solutions.

Our team handles every detail, creating spaces that feel intuitive, beautiful, and built for real life.

Ready to get started?
Complete the form to reach out today to schedule your bathroom remodeling consultation with Wade Design & Construction.
Details That Make a Difference

We don’t aim for “better than before.” We aim for “why didn’t we do this years ago?”

From the way the light hits the vanity in the morning to the quiet hush of a well-sealed shower, we consider how your bathroom will feel, sound, and function—day in and day out. These aren’t just design decisions. They’re lifestyle upgrades.

Every remodel includes thoughtful touches like:
Custom vanities with storage that works for your routine

Whether it’s a luxurious primary bath, a hardworking powder room, or a full update to a dated hall bathroom, our team brings focused intention to every design. We don’t just do “custom.” We do what makes sense for you.

You won’t have to juggle multiple contacts or manage communication between separate companies. We handle it all—ensuring a smoother experience and a result that feels cohesive from the ground up.

SPECIALTY PROJECTS
Custom Projects. Tailored Spaces. Built Around You.

Not every project fits neatly into a category. Some spaces call for creativity, engineering, and a team that knows how to bring unconventional ideas to life—without cutting corners.

At Wade Design & Construction, we specialize in custom projects. The “can you do this?” ideas. The “we’ve never really loved this space” challenges. The “we want something that feels like us” requests. From screened porches that become favorite hangout spots to wine rooms built with collectors in mind, we take on unique renovations with the same level of care and intention we bring to every project.

If it needs vision, planning, and precision, we're in.

Ready to get started?
Complete the form to reach out today to schedule your specialty project remodeling consultation with Wade Design & Construction.
You Dream It. We Design It. Then We Bring It to Life.

Specialty projects are often the most personal. These aren’t standard upgrades—they’re spaces designed around how you live and what you value.

Some of our recent custom projects include:
Screened-in porches with lighting, ceiling fans, and true indoor-outdoor flow
Wine rooms with custom racking, climate control, and architectural lighting
Basements with wet bars, media rooms, guest suites, and home gyms
Front porch additions that completely transform curb appeal and entry function
Creative storage tucked into unexpected spaces
One-of-a-kind nooks, built-ins, and bonus areas designed with purpose
No two are the same—and that’s exactly the point.
What Makes It "Specialty?"

If your project doesn’t fit under kitchen, bathroom, or whole-home remodeling but still requires smart design and skilled craftsmanship, it likely lives here.

Specialty projects are often custom, sometimes complex, and always high-impact. They might involve structural changes, technical challenges, or architectural details other builders and remodelers avoid. We don’t shy away from those—we lean in.

Bring us your idea. We’ll bring the experience and know-how to make it happen.

VIEW OUR PORTFOLIO

Built With Intention. Delivered With Precision.

Whether you’re carving out a space to gather, a place to retreat, or something entirely unique, we approach every specialty project with the same mindset: thoughtful design, clear communication, and craftsmanship that holds up over time.

Our team manages each step—from initial concept to final trim—ensuring nothing gets lost along the way.

Have a Unique Project in Mind?
Let’s talk. Whether it’s a custom wine room, a cozy back porch, or a basement you’ll actually want to spend time in, we’re here to help you explore what’s possible—and then build it like it was our own.
Contact Wade Design & Construction today to start the conversation.

Bonniwell Whole Home Transformation
MEQUON, WISCONSIN
Set on a quiet, woodsy lot in Mequon, this home got a top-to-bottom refresh to better suit a busy family and their everyday life. We reimagined nearly every space—from the kitchen and mudroom to the bedrooms, bathrooms, and sunroom—blending timeless structure with thoughtful updates. Arched openings, layered textures, and rich finishes give the home character, while custom cabinetry, updated tilework, and plenty of natural light bring comfort and style to every room. The result is a whole-home transformation that feels fresh, welcoming, and made to last.
We reworked nearly every inch of this first floor to turn a dated layout into a warm, functional space for family living and entertaining. In the kitchen, coffered ceilings, arched openings, and layered finishes create a sense of timeless character, while natural light and custom cabinetry keep things fresh and inviting. The new mudroom, butler’s pantry, sunroom, powder room, and living room were all thoughtfully updated to feel cohesive yet distinct, with details like brick accents, bold cabinetry, and modern lighting pulling everything together.
Upstairs, we focused on comfort, color, and creating personalized spaces for each family member. The primary suite now features a spa-inspired bathroom and a custom closet that feels like its own retreat. We refreshed three additional bathrooms—each paired with a bedroom for the kids and guests—with updated vanities, modern tilework, and just the right amount of personality. The laundry room was also reimagined with functionality and style in mind, making everyday routines feel a little easier (and a lot better looking).
